# Coefficient formula attribution

K-weighting formulas in ../../loudness.js adapt the public MIT-licensed coefficient construction from libebur128 v1.2.6, commit 67b33abe1558160ed76ada1322329b0e9e058b02. Runtime is independently implemented JavaScript; no native libebur128 binary ships. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiixyj/libebur128/67b33abe1558160ed76ada1322329b0e9e058b02/ebur128/ebur128.c . COPYING retained. Original source is used separately as a local reference for verification.
